basics.name: Gold Edward Edem Hogan
basics.label: AI Integration Engineer at PilotSpan LLC | BSc. IT (2023) | SvelteKit, Rust, AI & Cloud
basics.summary: AI Integration Engineer at PilotSpan LLC. Full-stack developer in SvelteKit, TypeScript, Python, and Rust. Builds AI-driven applications, scalable web platforms, and algorithmic trading systems. Deploys end to end on AWS, Cloudflare, Docker, and CI/CD.

projects.name: calm — JSON Resume theme
projects.description: Published npm theme (jsonresume-theme-calm) that keeps jobs and headings whole across page breaks instead of splitting them. Its site renders any GitHub user's resume.json gist client-side, so no server ever holds a resume.

projects.name: DevCircles Industry Insight Report
projects.description: Investor-facing directory of 43 products built by the DevCircles community. SvelteKit on Cloudflare Workers with Qdrant as the only datastore; deal cards ordered silently by traction, dated figures with freshness decay, grouping by traction/sector/country/state, raising filters and a /raising page, investor interest capture routed to an owner inbox, and JSON-LD for search. Builders sign in with Google to edit their own listing.

projects.name: x2
projects.description: SvelteKit social app where you search rooms built around shared interests, join in a click, or match one-to-one — no feed, no profile to perform for. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with a Qdrant vector store, WebSocket realtime, push notifications, groups, emoji/stickers and R2 image upload, plus an AI thread powered by the Vercel AI SDK with streaming reasoning. Google OAuth and Paystack integrated.

projects.name: Chess AI Training App
projects.description: Chess training platform where users play Stockfish across 10 difficulty levels. The Groq AI coach has full awareness of the board state and move history — it explains why each hint is suggested and answers any question like why the opponent made a particular move. Features Google OAuth, Paystack payments, Cloudflare Workers.

projects.name: MT5 Neural Network EAs
projects.description: Algorithmic trading system for MetaTrader 5 (Gold & Bitcoin). Features Python scripts for tick data processing and training Mamba state-space neural networks. Exports trained AI models to ONNX format for live execution in MQL5.

projects.name: Crypto Arbitrage Bot
projects.description: Automated cryptocurrency arbitrage trading system built in TypeScript. Leverages the ccxt library to monitor and execute cross-exchange arbitrage opportunities.

projects.name: ApexLinks
projects.description: SvelteKit platform to list businesses, products, and services. Features AI-powered vector search for blogs/listings and an integrated AI resume builder that autonomously generates complete content and styling.

projects.name: AI Image Creation Assistant
projects.description: Prompt engineering tool that helps users craft robust AI image prompts. Features a click-and-drop library for style and scenario keywords, and integrates directly with DALL-E / image generation APIs to render outputs.

projects.name: Image Scale
projects.description: SvelteKit web tool for image rescaling. Core resizing logic is implemented in Rust and compiled to WASM for high performance, featuring user toggles to preserve the original aspect ratio.

projects.name: Report Card Management Webapp
projects.description: School management system backed by Qdrant and SvelteKit. Enables teachers to log student scores, auto-computes final pass/fail grades, and generates comprehensive PDF report cards at the end of the term.

projects.name: Travel Ticketing WebApp Frontend
projects.description: React-based flight booking UI allowing users to input travel dates and select their preferred plane and seats (TIIDELab team project).

projects.name: CBT Web App
projects.description: Full-stack SvelteKit application for educators to create, save, and administer quizzes and tests, supporting objective, short-answer, and essay question formats.

projects.name: c6 — Site Ledger
projects.description: Material & progress control app for small residential builders. Track every material order → delivery → usage, enforce engineer benchmarks, and surface discrepancies (negative stock, over-delivery, waste) in real time, plus drawings, milestones, and a grounded AI site assistant. Built as a single SvelteKit app on Cloudflare Workers: Qdrant as the only datastore with semantic search, Cloudflare R2 for drawings/photos, OpenRouter embeddings + chat, Google OAuth sign-in with HMAC-signed sessions, secrets via Cloudflare Secrets Store and deployed through Workers Builds CI.
